items.title: Ground shimmer - aniso 4 -> 8
items.why: Cause MEASURED off the owner's own capture, not theorised.
items.evidence:
single-pixel contrast by depth:
  near  hp1  9.1
  mid   hp1  29.4   <- 3.2x worse further away
  far   hp1  23.7
Flat 1px..16px at mid-field = Nyquist noise. Mipmaps were ON.
Cause: aniso:4 on a plane at grazing pitch.
Fix: aniso 8 in all 16 layer metas AND the importer.
Desktop hid it (anisotropicTextures:2 = force 16x); Seeker_High honours 4.

items.title: Operator kill switches - the seal as the player reads it
items.why: A server-shaped payload goes in through MaintenanceCatalog.ApplyPayload - the same seam the live /api/maintenance response uses - and the text shot is whatever MaintenanceBannerDriver decides to say about it. Nothing here is hand-typed.
items.evidence: UI_CAPTURE_OK on Builds/w10-cap3. Line under the shot: 'MAINTENANCE ON RAIDS - Raids are closed while we fix the reward payout. Back shortly.'

items.title: The same screenshot found two defects the green gates could not
items.why: Read the image, not the marker: the operator message truncates to '...whil...', so the player learns an area is shut and never learns why. It also exposed that the regression asserts MaintenanceCatalog.BannerText(), which has NO runtime caller - the player sees a different producer entirely.
items.evidence: Ticket minted as WO-1245 with both defects and a grep proving BannerText() is production-dead.
